description: SLOs, alerts, and error budgets for the deny-by-default multi-tenant API-key vault. Tenant isolation is enforced by core.mjs owned() chokepoint; keys are stored as sha256 hashes only. These SLOs keep the service available, fast, and observable. No secret values are stored here.

slos.name: api-availability
slos.description: Fraction of HTTP requests that do NOT return a 5xx. 401/403/404/409 deny-by-default responses are correct behavior and are excluded from the error SLI.

slos.name: key-issue-latency-p99
slos.description: Fraction of POST /keys and POST /keys/:id/rotate calls (crypto mint + sha256 + persist to data.json) served under the p99 latency target of 300ms.

slos.name: key-verify-latency-p99
slos.description: Fraction of GET /keys and GET /keys/:id metadata reads served under the p99 latency target of 150ms. Reads are on the request hot path, so this budget is tight.
